messages.subject: Error with control.inla and lincomb
parts:
I am attempting to run a BYM model with random slope. I get the follow error after runnign the following code:

 a.bym<- inla(total_deaths20~ 1 + skin_temp_scaled+pol_pm25_scaled +     male_ratio_scaled+

          control.inla = list(lincomb.derived.only = FALSE))

lincomb.derived.only = FALSE

as that option was removed at some point. It is forced to be TRUE.
